## Slam Dunk Dashboard

Every projection we run, in your browser. The **Slam Dunk Dashboard** takes the same NBA & WNBA model that powers our Discord picks and puts it in a live, sortable board — with per-book line movement, a bet calculator, and our full graded track record.

::: subscribe-ctas
[Open the Dashboard](https://app.slamdunk.bet){.btn .btn-primary .btn-lg role="button"}
:::

### What you can do

- **Read the markets board** — every prop, ranked by edge. Best available book line and implied %, our model's fair line, the edge, and recommended units. Sort any column, then expand a game to see every book and how its line has moved.
- **Scan the game cards** — one card per game. Win tip, first team to score, first basket type, and our most likely first scorer for the WNBA; NRFI/YRFI, weather, projected lineups, and per-batter home-run odds for MLB.
- **Check the receipts** — season-to-date model tracking with net units and ROI by prop, plotted as a running total. The whole record is right there to scroll through.
- **Run the numbers** — a built-in bet calculator: enter a projected fair value and the book's price, get your edge and recommended unit size on any bet.
- **Cover both leagues** — WNBA first-basket and first-event markets, plus MLB home runs and first-inning runs.
- **Make it yours** — save your go-to sportsbooks, flip odds between percent and American, and switch light or dark, all tuned for desktop or phone. Lines and projections refresh on a schedule tied to tip-off.
